segments.text: You'll never believe who I ran into last weekend. Sophie, yeah, our old friend from school, Sophie. I was grabbing coffee downtown, standing in line, and when I looked up, there she was. At first, I wasn't even sure it was her. Shorter hair, new glasses, totally different style. But once she smiled, I recognized her right away. We ended up sitting down for a bit to catch up. She told me she's been living in another city for a while now, moved out there after college for work. She's in marketing, managing a small team, said it gets hectic sometimes, but she's really enjoying it. She actually seemed happy, which was nice to see. We started talking about old times, our group, those random hangouts after school, that trip we all took senior year. It's funny how easily those memories came back. She laughed remembering how we used to spend hours doing absolutely nothing, and somehow thought we were so busy. She asked about you, by the way, wanted to know what you've been up to. I told her you're doing great. Same energy, just more focused now. She smiled and said, "That sounds exactly like Emma." We wrapped up after a while. She had somewhere to be. But still, it felt nice. It's strange how someone can disappear from your life for years, and yet a short conversation can bring it all rushing back, familiar, effortless, like no time passed at all.
